scope: Real ARM WASM instructions and APP1 startup; no physical device evidence

cases.name: Scalar FP bits and aliases; wider register APIs rejected before engine invocation
Cortex-M7 readback, exact repeated slices, special registers
Guest MMIO loads and stores call the board
Repeated instruction preparation stops after 64 retries and remains resumable
One preparation per progressing instruction preserves the original slice budget
Injected public API and cleanup failures mark the backend terminal before reuse
Ordinary memory API errors remain recoverable; closed CPU APIs are rejected
Pre-instruction stop, resume, and unmapped fetch fault
Injected terminal engine failure blocks backend reuse and permits worker teardown
Instruction-boundary context publication precedes the guest load
Retired device DMA and modified XIP resume within the original budget

limitations: Board time counts instruction starts, not measured M7 cycles
FPU access permission faults and lazy exception stacking are not verified
This CPU test does not establish complete firmware peripherals or sampler operation
